scope: Original single-lecture guided telling of Sterne’s nine-volume novel (1759–1767), preserving comic digressions, birth, Walter/Toby, Le Fever, travel, widow and unresolved ending, not a chapter-by-chapter retelling.
editorial_boundary: A guided account of central arcs, not an exhaustive nine-volume translation or chronology. Public full text is freely accessible, while the Gifu transcription mixes named editions and the work includes material print effects that audio cannot reproduce.
